{{Quote|I killed Obi-Wan Kenobi!|Rako Hardeen|<ref name="Deception">{{TCW|Deception}}</ref>}}
'''Rako Hardeen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Sniper/Legends|marksman]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Concord Dawn/Legends|Concord Dawn]] who was active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You're blaming me for a murder I didn't even do.|Rako Hardeen|<ref name="Deception" />}}
Originally from [[Concord Dawn/Legends|Concord Dawn]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Hardeen was once a member of the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group known as [[Marvasa's Marauders]] in the [[Cyrillian Protectorate/Legends|Cyrillian Protectorate]].<ref name="TCWEG" /> During the Clone Wars, Hardeen found himself a pawn in a complex plot to foil an [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt on [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] organized by [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]] and [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. He was hired by an anonymous client, actually members of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], to murder [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] by shooting at him from the top of a building on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After shooting Kenobi in the chest as he had agreed, Hardeen was pursued by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] managed to escape using [[Smoke grenade/Legends|smoke grenades]] and a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]].

[[File:RakoHardeenRifle-SWE.png|thumb|250px|left|Hardeen was a skilled sniper.]]
While celebrating his high-profile kill at [[Trueping's/Legends|Trueping's cantina]], he was summoned into the back room to meet his employer and receive payment. There, he was met by Jedi Masters [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and Obi-Wan Kenobi&ndash;his supposed victim, now physically altered to look like him. Hardeen was apprehended by the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], and his identity assumed by Kenobi in order to plant himself in a [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic prison]]. Hardeen's reputation for having killed a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was essential to the plan, as Kenobi used it to gain the trust of other [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] and attract the attention of Moralo Eval, from whom Kenobi was to acquire intelligence that would help the Jedi prevent the assassination attempt. To gain intel, Obi-Wan Kenobi had to join Eval and [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] to escape from the prison through the [[Morgue/Legends|morgue]]. Bane had the security code wrong, which prompted Kenobi to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to open the security door, saying he needed Moralo and Bane to watch for [[Security Guard/Legends|guards]] to conceal his true identity. After making a hasty escape from the prison, the trio headed for [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] for a new [[Starship/Legends|ship]] and weapons. After arriving onto the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], Kenobi, still disguised as Hardeen, was betrayed by Cad Bane, and was arrested shorty after. Eventually, he got free from the planet after the betrayal of Bane. They both went to the planet where Eval had a test for some bounty hunters. Kenobi, as Hardeen, passed all the tests and gained the trust of Bane. Moralo, however, wanted to prove that "Rako Hardeen" was not going to be as effective of a leader as him, after [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] suggested the two fight to the [[Death/Legends|death]]. Eval lost his fight against Kenobi, and Dooku gave the order to kill Eval, but Kenobi couldn't bring himself to kill him. Kenobi then had to execute the plan but made contact with the Jedi guarding the [[Sun Festival/Legends|Sun Festival]].

The plan was executed perfectly. They lost some bounty hunters and Kenobi revealed himself when Anakin and Mace Windu showed up.

==Behind the scenes==
Rako Hardeen first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series episode "[[Deception]]." He was voiced by [[James Arnold Taylor]], who also provided the voice of Obi-Wan Kenobi on the series.

The helmet that Obi-Wan wore while impersonating Hardeen was based on early concept art for [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|helmet]].

Originally, the episode "[[The Box]]" would have included a storyline in which [[Anakin Skywalker]] would have searched for the real Hardeen once he discovered that Kenobi was alive. Though the [[Jedi High Council]] would have denied Hardeen's existence, Skywalker would have intercepted Captain [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] transferring Hardeen off-world, leading the Council to divulge the truth. The thread was cut for time constraints, clarity and character focus, in addition that Rex would have kept a secret from Anakin.<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-box-trivia-gallery|text="The Box" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 6}}</ref>
